title: The hosted-CI carrier leaves P05.4; the hosted run is done separately
decision: The hosted-CI Validation bullet (D73 п.4) is removed from the P05.4 spec, together with the phase-closure wording that depended on it. P05.4 closes on its local Validation (self-check review, `light`). Phase P05 is **not** closed by this decision: D73 still requires a green workflow `CI` on the final phase commit, and the owner runs that (the push, the read of the run, repair of any red job) separately with the "sol" executor. Until that evidence exists the phase stays open and `@plan/plan.json` names the requirement. The spec edit changes the design fingerprint, so this decision carries a `design-audit-waiver/v1` for the new fingerprint and replaces D88 in `@plan/plan.json`; no repeated whole-plan design audit is assigned (the change deletes one Validation bullet and rewords two lines, routes, order and review are unchanged).
rationale: The owner does not want hosted CI handled in this session. Closing P05.4 with the bullet unsatisfied is forbidden by plan-lint (D76), so the carrier has to move rather than be skipped. The owner also asked for an independent review on `codex/gpt-6.1-sol` (high); that is a separate read-only run and is not started from this session.
